title: Listen for humpback whales off Maui
description: Join a winter whale-watching boat with a naturalist and keep an eye on the water for blows, flukes, and the occasional breach. If the operator uses a hydrophone, you may also hear whale song from beneath the hull. The sounds add another dimension to Maui’s winter migration, even on a day when the whales stay mostly below the surface.
teaser: Watch humpbacks and listen beneath the boat.
goodToKnow: January and February are often good months for whale watching. Confirm boat access and sea conditions; whale behavior varies, and no swimming is needed.
whyItMightDelightYou: Hearing a whale before you can see one makes the open ocean feel suddenly full of life.
